theater: 江陵、鄂州與峽口（長江中游）

battle.name: 唐平蕭銑之戰
battle.theater: 江陵、鄂州與峽口（長江中游）
battle.brief: 武德四年（621）三月，唐廷命荊州總管李孝恭率軍沿長江東下，討平據江陵、鄂州的梁宗室蕭銑。戰役自峽口打到江陵城，四月至五月主力戰鬥沿長江中游展開，蕭銑兵敗被擒，押送長安。卡面埃及長矛是早王朝的守城刺擊兵器，正對應江陵城頭以長柄矛槊抵禦雲梯與攻城塔的實況。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰雙方，一方是唐，關中起家的新王朝；另一方是蕭銑的割據政權，承南朝梁的名號而自居正統。唐方由高祖李淵統籌，以荊州總管李孝恭為主將，舟師與步兵沿長江自襄州方向東下，水陸並進；同一時間，北方戰線上還有竇建德（河北）、王世充（洛陽）、劉武周（並州）三處未平，唐廷必須在蕭銑與北方之間分派兵力。蕭銑一方以梁武帝蕭衍的宗室身分據江陵，兼領鄂州與峽口一帶，倚長江天險與舟師自守；他於隋末乘亂自立，太平二年（557）一度自稱帝號，曾遣使往北方政權通好求援，並與南朝陳在長江中下游長期對峙。戰役背後還站著江南殘存的割據者：吳郡的沈法興、洪州的林士弘、廣州的馮盎與高涼的冼氏勢力，多持觀望態度，等唐軍與蕭銑互相消耗。江陵以內，蕭銑收攏梁末舊將與荊襄降戶，兵力以步兵與水軍為主，器械則承襲南朝舊藏，以及隋廷散落在江南各地的攻城之具。
countriesEn: Two sides fought this war. One was the Tang, the new dynasty that had risen in the Guanzhong basin; the other was the separatist regime of Xiao Xian, which carried on the name of the Southern Liang and claimed its legitimate succession. The Tang side was directed by the founding emperor, Li Yuan, with Li Xiaogong, commander of the Jingzhou circuit, as the field commander: river flotillas and infantry moved east down the Yangtze from the direction of Xiangzhou, advancing by land and by water at the same time. At the same moment three other fronts remained open in the north — Dou Jiande in Hebei, Wang Shichong at Luoyang and Liu Wuzhou in Bingzhou — so the Tang court had to divide its forces between Xiao Xian and the north. Xiao Xian's side, using his descent from the Liang house of Emperor Wu of Liang, held Jiangling and also controlled Yuezhou and the mouths of the gorges, relying on the natural fortress of the Yangtze and on his river fleet. He had raised himself amid the disorder at the end of the Sui, and in Taiping 2 (557) he had briefly assumed the imperial title; he had also sent envoys to the northern regimes to seek support, and he had faced the Southern Chen for years along the middle and lower Yangtze. Behind the war stood the separatists still surviving in Jiangnan: Shen Faxing in Wujun, Lin Shihong in Hongzhou, Feng Ang in Guangzhou and the Xian clan at Gaoliang, all of whom sat on the fence, waiting for the Tang army and Xiao Xian to wear each other out. Inside Jiangling, Xiao Xian had gathered the old generals of the late Liang together with surrendered men from Jing and Xiang; his troops were mainly infantry and river soldiers, and his equipment was inherited from Liang-era stores and from the siege materials the Sui had left scattered across Jiangnan.
people: 推動這場戰役走向的有三類人。第一類是唐廷的核心：李淵在武德四年春一面令荊州線出兵，一面把主力投向虎牢關與洛陽，秦王李世民以數千騎破竇建德十餘萬之眾、逼王世充出降，唐廷在北方與江漢兩線同時得手，才有餘力收拾蕭銑；荊州總管李孝恭受命經略江陵，是正面戰線的指揮者，他麾下的舟師與攻城器械是突破峽口與江陵城防的主力。第二類是蕭銑本人：他是梁武帝蕭衍之孫、豫章王蕭綜之子，承聖初年襲封湘東王，據江陵數十年，太平二年自稱帝，志在重張梁室；但他手握的只有名分，實控的只有荊鄂一隅，起兵以來對北方求援與自身決斷又互有拉扯，兵敗之後仍未能組織起有效的抵抗。第三類是背景中的人物：南朝陳武帝陳霸先與蕭銑在長江中下游對峙多年，兩方都避免在唐軍介入時兩敗俱傷；侯景之亂與西魏破江陵之後，南朝舊族四散，蕭銑帳下多為收攏的降卒與舊將，忠誠與戰力都有限；嶺南冼夫人曾遣其孫馮盎率兵助隋討平江南餘部，馮氏一系在唐廷經略嶺南時更成了重要的助力。
peopleEn: Three kinds of person determined the course of this war. The first was the Tang court itself: in the spring of Wude 4 Li Yuan ordered the Jingzhou line into the field while committing his main effort to Hulao and Luoyang, and the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, broke Dou Jiande's claimed host of more than a hundred thousand with a few thousand cavalry and forced Wang Shichong to surrender; only after winning on the northern and the middle Yangtze fronts at once did the court have the strength to dispose of Xiao Xian. Li Xiaogong, commander of Jingzhou, was charged with the middle Yangtze and commanded the front line, and the river flotilla and siege machines under him were what broke the gorge positions and the defences of Jiangling. The second was Xiao Xian himself. He was a grandson of Liang Wudi, Xiao Yan, and a son of Prince Yuzhang, Xiao Zong; in the first years of Chengsheng he inherited the title Prince of Xiangdong, and for decades he held Jiangling, assuming the imperial title in Taiping 2 in the hope of restoring the Liang house. In his hands he had only legitimacy; in fact he controlled only the corner of Jing and E. Since raising his banner he had wavered between seeking help from the north and his own resolution, and even after defeat he could not organise an effective resistance. The third group was the background cast: the Chen emperor Wu, Chen Baxian, had confronted Xiao Xian for years along the middle and lower Yangtze, and both sides were careful not to destroy each other just as the Tang army entered. After the Hou Jing rebellion and the fall of Jiangling to the Western Wei, the old clans of the south had scattered, and Xiao Xian's ranks were mostly surrendered soldiers and leftover generals, with limited loyalty and limited fighting quality. In Lingnan, the Lady Xian had once sent her grandson Feng Ang with troops to help the Sui put down the remaining separatists in Jiangnan, and the Feng line became a useful ally when the Tang court turned to Lingnan.
kits: 卡面這把埃及長矛不會出現在唐軍的序列之內，但它是理解這場戰役裝備的正確座標。它是埃及早王朝（約公元前3200年前後）的長柄刺擊兵器：銅或青銅矛頭以榫、繩或銅箍固定在木杆上，刃部短而寬，重心落在杆的中後段，最早的用途正如其卡片所記，是守城垣——在城頭對攀城的敵人作近距離刺擊，後來也用來收復失地。放到621年的長江中游，這條技術路線的對位物是唐軍的槊與矛：槊是步將與騎將所用的長柄兵器，杆長過兩米，鐵鏃或鐵刃裝在木柲之上；矛則是制式配發的通用刺擊兵器，銅或鐵矛頭套於木杆。戰役裡真正決定攻城成敗的並不是矛槊，而是弩與攻城器械：蹶張弩、臂弩與弓箭在城外壓制城頭，唐軍以雲梯、巢車、木鵲貼城，以撞車撞門、以發石車拋石，另備舟師蒙衝、斗艦、樓船與走舸，用火箭與火船逼燒水面船隻。步兵防護靠皮甲、札甲與兩當，甲胄以兜鍪配明光甲為主；騎兵是唐軍的機動骨幹；糧秣則靠江上轉運船隊自襄州一路輸送，後方以驛馬傳令、烽燧報警。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card would never appear in a Tang rank, and yet it is the right coordinate for understanding the equipment of this war. It is a long-handled thrusting weapon of the Egyptian Old Kingdom, roughly 3200 BC: a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft by tenon, cord or bronze binding, with a short broad blade and the balance of the weight sitting toward the rear of the shaft. Its earliest use, exactly as the card records, was the defence of city walls — stabbing at close range those who climbed them from the ramparts — and it was later used to recover lost ground. Placed in the middle Yangtze in 621, the counterpart of that technological line in Tang hands was the shao and the mao: the shao, a long-handled weapon carried by foot soldiers and cavalry, had a shaft of more than two metres with an iron point or iron blade socketed to a wooden core, while the mao was the standard-issue general thrusting weapon, a copper or iron head slipped onto a wooden shaft. What actually decided the assault in this campaign was not the spear but the crossbow and the siege machines: the drawn crossbow, the arm crossbow and the bow held the ramparts down from outside; the Tang used ladders, movable towers and wooden sparrows against the walls, battering rams against the gates and stone-throwing engines against the fabric of the city, and they brought a river fleet of rams, fighting boats, tower ships and light runners, using fire arrows and fire ships to burn the craft on the water. Infantry were protected by leather armour, lamellar armour and the two-part cuirass, with a helmet and bright armour as the usual combination; cavalry was the mobile backbone of the Tang army; and grain and supplies came up the river in transport boats from Xiangzhou, with relay horses carrying orders and beacon fires signalling warnings behind the front.
tactics: 這一役的戰術骨架是水陸配合下的順流攻勢。唐軍不急於強攻江陵，先以舟師沿江上溯，取峽口、斷蕭銑上游之兵，再以步兵傍江岸挺進，護住運糧船隊，使蕭銑無法從上游得到援兵；蕭銑的防禦則倚江陵城與峽道之險，把舟師列於江面，把弓弩手置於城頭與岸壘，以矢石封鎖水道。唐軍在江陵城下架雲梯、發石車，亦曾以穴地掘進逼近城基，但江陵城垣高厚、當日守軍尚有戰力，破城主要靠器械持續壓制與守軍內部的崩解。城破之後，蕭銑部的將士在江上與江陵附近的村邑四散，唐軍分路追擊：一部沿江東取鄂州，斷其退路，一部控制渡口與糧道，避免潰兵重整。最終的勝負並非在一次會戰中決定，而是在糧秣消耗、渡口控制與士氣此消彼長的過程中傾斜；蕭銑既無法從北方得到實際援助，也得不到陳朝與江南其他割據者的配合，於是陷於孤立。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this campaign was a downstream offensive fought with water and land in combination. The Tang did not rush the walls of Jiangling. They first pushed river flotillas upstream to seize the mouths of the gorges and cut Xiao Xian off from any force coming down from above, then marched infantry along the bank to protect the supply boats, so that no reinforcement could reach the defender from upstream. Xiao Xian's defence rested on the fortress of Jiangling and the narrows of the gorges: he ranged his river boats on the water and posted bowmen and crossbowmen on the ramparts and in the shore entrenchments, sealing the channel with arrows and stones. Under the walls the Tang set up ladders and stone-throwing engines and at times tried to drive a covered tunnel forward beneath the foundations, but the walls of Jiangling were high and thick and the defenders still had some strength that day, so the city was brought down mainly by continuous pressure from the siege machines and by the collapse of the garrison from within. Once the city had fallen, Xiao Xian's soldiers scattered along the river and through the villages around Jiangling, and the Tang pursued them in several columns: one marched east along the river to seize Yuezhou and cut off the road of escape, another held the crossings and the supply route so that the fugitives could not re-form. The outcome was not decided in a single pitched battle but tilted through the attrition of provisions, the control of the crossings and the slow rise and fall of morale. Xiao Xian could get no real aid from the north and no cooperation from Chen or from the other separatists of Jiangnan, and he was therefore left isolated.
data: 可核對的數字不多，這場戰役在正史中留下的記載本來就簡短。系年方面：蕭銑的割據起於隋大業十八年（618）之後，隋亡唐立，而他自己自太平二年（557）自稱帝號起據江陵，到武德四年（621）亡國，前後六十四年；唐自建國到平定蕭銑，用了三年；距隋平陳（589）則已三十二年。人物方面，蕭銑生於537年，卒於621年，虛歲八十四。地理上，江陵與鄂州相距約五六百里江程；蕭銑被擒後自江陵押解京師長安，水陸兼行逾一千五百里。兵力數字在傳世文獻中多以「數萬」概之，未見可細考之數；可以對照的是同年三月秦王李世民在虎牢關以數千騎破竇建德號稱十餘萬之眾、五月洛陽王世充出降，可見唐廷當年用兵之緊。器械方面，隋唐制式槊通長可逾二米，早王朝的埃及銅矛頭多長十數厘米，銅器之屬遠不能與唐軍的鐵器同日而語。史料主要為《資治通鑑》卷一百八十九、《舊唐書》高祖紀與相關將臣列傳，所載合計不過數十言。
dataEn: Few numbers can be checked, because the record of this war in the official histories is short to begin with. On the chronology: Xiao Xian's separatism began after the fall of the Sui in Daye 18 (618), the year the Sui collapsed and the Tang was founded; from the assumption of the imperial title in Taiping 2 (557) to the end of his regime in Wude 4 (621) he held Jiangling for sixty-four years. The Tang needed three years from its own foundation to subdue him, and it was already thirty-two years since the Sui had destroyed Chen in 589. On persons: Xiao Xian was born in 537 and died in 621, at the counted age of eighty-four. On geography: Jiangling and Yuezhou are about five or six hundred li of river apart, and after his capture Xiao Xian was taken from Jiangling to the Tang capital at Chang'an, more than fifteen hundred li by a mixture of water and road. Troop numbers in the transmitted sources are given only as several tens of thousands, with no figure that can be examined closely; the comparison available is that in the same year, in March, the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, broke Dou Jiande's claimed host of more than a hundred thousand at Hulao with a few thousand cavalry, and that Wang Shichong came out of Luoyang in May, which shows how tightly the Tang court's resources were stretched that year. On equipment: the regulation shao of the Sui and Tang could exceed two metres in length, whereas the copper heads of Old Kingdom Egyptian spears are mostly a dozen-odd centimetres long; bronze and iron are not to be compared. The principal sources are the juan 189 of the Zizhi Tongjian, the Gaozu annals of the Jiu Tangshu and the biographies of the commanders involved, which between them amount to no more than a few dozen lines.
cause: 打起來的原因是多層的。第一層是隋末秩序崩解留下的真空：隋朝平陳只是統一了江南的名義，陳亡之後江陵一帶仍由梁宗室蕭銑掌握，他擁兵自重，隋廷雖曾遣將討伐而未能根本解決；到隋末天下大亂，江南更有吳郡沈法興、洪州林士弘、廣州馮盎等各自據守，長江中游成了誰也不能獨立的真空地帶。第二層是唐的戰略需要：唐在關中與關東取得決定性優勢之後，統一南北的次序自然指向江南；先取江陵，既能切斷江南割據者彼此策應的樞紐，也能打通自襄州入江漢的水路，使江漢以西的巴蜀與江漢以東的吳越不再能聲氣相通。第三層是蕭銑與北方政權的關係：他在南方另立旗幟，又曾遣使往北方求援借勢，於是對唐而言，平蕭銑不只是打一個地方勢力，更是斷掉江南與北方敵對力量重新結合的可能。第四層是蕭銑自身的僵局：他自稱帝號多年，坐擁名分與地盤卻無力整合江南諸部，一旦唐軍以主力南下，他既談不成，也無力久戰。
causeEn: There were several layers to the reasons for the war. The first was the vacuum left by the collapse of Sui order at the end of the dynasty. The Sui had destroyed Chen and thereby unified Jiangnan only in name; after the fall of Chen the region of Jiangling remained in the hands of the Liang clansman Xiao Xian, who armed himself and ruled as his own master, and although the Sui court had sent generals against him it had never settled the matter. When the empire came apart, the separatists of Jiangnan multiplied — Shen Faxing in Wujun, Lin Shihong in Hongzhou, Feng Ang in Guangzhou — and the middle Yangtze became a no man's land in which none of them could stand alone. The second layer was the Tang court's strategic need. Once the Tang had won the decisive struggles in Guanzhong and in the lands east of the passes, the natural order of reunification pointed at Jiangnan; taking Jiangling first would cut the hinge by which the Jiangnan separatists supported one another, and would open the water route from Xiangzhou into the Jing and Han region, so that Bashu on one side of the river and Wuyue on the other could no longer keep in touch. The third layer was Xiao Xian's relations with the northern regimes: having raised a banner of his own in the south, he had also sent envoys north to borrow strength, so for the Tang, defeating him was not merely the business of beating a local strongman but of foreclosing any new alliance between Jiangnan and hostile northern power. The fourth layer was the deadlock of Xiao Xian himself: for years he had held the imperial title, sitting on legitimacy and territory but unable to integrate the various powers of Jiangnan, and once the Tang committed its main force to the south he could neither negotiate his way out nor fight a long war.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是唐在江南最後一次大規模割據的終結，作用遠比戰役本身的規模要大。第一，江陵與鄂州歸唐，長江中游自此納入唐的版圖，唐廷自襄州至江陵、鄂州的水路與州縣建置得以貫通，統一江南的戰略從此由西向東推進，先後平定吳郡的沈法興、洪州的林士弘與嶺南的馮盎，障礙基本清除。第二，蕭梁宗室的武裝勢力在六十四年後徹底退出歷史舞台，南朝以來以宗室為核心的地方割據模式告一段落，陳朝在長江下游所受的壓力也為之減輕。第三，江南的秩序重整：江陵自侯景之亂與西魏破城之後已是殘城，唐平定後復置荊州，招收流亡、招撫山區部眾，遷徙與安置沿江居民；南渡的士族與文物在亂世中大量散佚，部分經嶺南入廣州，馮盎與冼氏一系在彼處承接了一部分文教傳統，而唐廷設州置縣、括戶編丁的做法也由此深入嶺南。第四，在技術史上，隋唐統一之後的兵器標準化——直刀與環首刀、鐵槊、鎗、弩——最終取代了從早王朝銅矛一路演化過來的舊形制；唐軍正是靠著這一套鐵製長兵與強弩、攻城器械，才在不到一年的時間內解決了江陵。
impactEn: The result of this war was the end of the last great separatism in Jiangnan, and its consequences were far larger than the scale of the campaign. First, Jiangling and Yuezhou passed to the Tang and the middle Yangtze was drawn into the Tang sphere, so that the water route and the chain of prefectures and counties from Xiangzhou to Jiangling and Yuezhou could be made continuous; the strategy of unifying Jiangnan then ran eastward, and the separatists of Wujun, of Hongzhou and of Lingnan were put down in turn, so that almost all the obstacles were removed. Second, the armed power of the Liang house left the stage of history after sixty-four years, and the pattern of local separatism built around princely blood that had run since the Southern dynasties came to an end; the pressure on Chen along the lower Yangtze was correspondingly eased. Third, the order of Jiangnan was rebuilt. Jiangling had been a ruined city since the Hou Jing rebellion and the fall of the city to the Western Wei, and after the Tang put things right they re-established Jingzhou, gathered in the displaced, and pacified the tribal people of the hills, moving and resettling the people of the river banks. The clans and the books of the south had been scattered in great part during the disorder, some carried down into Lingnan and to Guangzhou, where the Feng Ang and Xian line took over part of the literary tradition, and the Tang practice of establishing prefectures and counties and of registering households and persons pushed deep into the far south in the same way. Fourth, in the history of technology, the standardisation of weapons that followed the Sui-Tang reunification — straight swords and ring-pommel swords, iron shao, the long double-edged qiang, the crossbow — finally displaced the older forms that had evolved in a line from the Old Kingdom bronze spear; it was precisely this kit of iron pole-arms, strong crossbows and siege machines that allowed the Tang to settle Jiangling in less than a year.
result: 武德四年（621）春末夏初，唐軍在長江中游得手。蕭銑的舟師在江上被壓制，峽口與江陵一線的守備瓦解，江陵城破；其部眾並非成建制地戰至最後，而是沿江與沿鄉里散去，一部西走鄂州、一部散入湘中。唐軍分路追捕，蕭銑最後在走投無路中被擒，押送長安，同年之內伏誅，歷時約六十四年的梁宗室政權就此終結。江陵及鄂州一帶歸唐，唐廷復置荊州，置官屬治其事，招集流亡、撫循舊戶；那些在戰亂中散入山澤的舊部，後來多由州縣招慰收編，化成編戶齊民。回頭看，這場戰爭的勝負並沒有驚天動地的會戰：蕭銑一方輸在孤立的處境——北方無援、江南無應、士無鬥志；唐廷則輸不起，一旦江陵不下，江南各割據者就會聯手自保。因此這場戰爭最終以最省兵力的方式收場，也讓唐統一江南的最後一大段路變得平坦。史書對這一過程記載簡略，具體日期、交戰次數與兵力數字多不可考，但可確定的是：它結束了蕭銑的割據，也讓唐順著長江一路收拾江南，成為此後數年統一工作的起點。
resultEn: In the late spring and early summer of Wude 4 (621) the Tang army had its way in the middle Yangtze. Xiao Xian's river fleet was pinned down on the water, the defences along the gorge and the Jiangling line fell apart, and the city was taken. His soldiers did not fight in formed order to the last; they scattered along the river and through the villages, some moving west toward Yuezhou and some into the hills of Xiang. The Tang pursued them in several columns, and Xiao Xian was finally caught with nowhere left to go, taken to Chang'an, and executed within that same year; a Liang princely regime that had lasted about sixty-four years was thereby ended. Jiangling and the district of Yuezhou passed to the Tang, which re-established Jingzhou, appointed officials to administer it, gathered in the displaced and cared for the old households; the old troops who had scattered into the hills during the fighting were later taken in by the prefectures and counties, pacified and enrolled, and turned into registered commoners. Looking back, the result of this war was not decided by any earth-shattering pitched battle: Xiao Xian's side lost because of its isolation — no help from the north, no response from Jiangnan, and no heart left in the troops — while the Tang could not afford to lose, because if Jiangling were not taken the separatists of Jiangnan would have combined to defend themselves. The war thus ended in the least costly way, and it made the last long stretch of the Tang road through Jiangnan plain. The official histories record this process only briefly, and the exact dates, the number of engagements and the troop figures are largely irrecoverable; what can be certain is that it ended Xiao Xian's separatism and left the Tang free to move along the Yangtze and take Jiangnan piece by piece, which was the starting point of the work of unification in the years that followed.
